title: C01 Vehicle Type Approval (Livestock) incl. C05 Loading Density & Capacity
description: Certificate of approval of a means of transport by road for long journeys (Art. 18), consolidated with the vehicle capacity data needed to check space allowances (Annex I, Chapter VII) at loading.

x-traced.status: pre-project draft — subject to change in T4.1
x-traced.issuer: Competent authority or body designated by the Member State (Art. 18(1)).
x-traced.holder: Transporter (legal-entity wallet); bound to the vehicle by VIN.
verifiers: Competent authority of the place of departure (Art. 14(1)(a)(i))
Competent authority of the country of destination (Art. 6(8))
Official veterinarians at control posts and exit points (Art. 21(1)(d))
legalBasis: Reg (EC) No 1/2005 Annex I, Chapters II, VI and VII
Reg (EC) No 1/2005 Annex III, Chapter IV (specimen certificate)
x-traced.forwardCompatibility: COM(2023) 770 (proposal) — forward-compatibility only: model certificate of approval of means of transport by road (owner, vehicle identification, max decks, max surface, species/categories).
useCases: UC-3 official verification at control points
openQuestions: Whether the capacity profile is issued by the authority or computed by the operator from floor area (then C05 claims move to the I01 anchor).

approvalCertificateNumber.description: Number unique in the issuing Member State (Art. 18(2)).

vehicle.description: Vehicle identification. Claim names kept aligned with vehicle-registration attestations (mVRC) so the two can be linked by VIN.

owner.description: Owner identification as in the specimen certificate.

speciesCategories.description: Species/categories the vehicle is approved to transport.

usableFloorAreaPerDeckM2.description: Usable floor area per deck, in m² (C05). Input to the space-allowance check.

equipment.description: Long-journey equipment found compliant at inspection (Annex I, Chapter VI).

waterTankCapacityLitres.description: Chapter VI, point 2.3 (≥ 1.5 % of max payload)

capacityProfile.description: C05: informative maximum loading per species/category and weight class, derived from floor area and Annex I, Chapter VII. The binding check is the rules-as-code determination at loading, per journey.

inspection.description: Inspection on which the approval rests (Art. 18(1)(b)).

issuingAuthority.description: Competent authority or designated body that granted the approval.

validUntil.description: Not more than five years; invalid as soon as the vehicle is modified or refitted in a way that affects animal welfare (Art. 18(2)).
